evidence.statement: All 3,664 pre-frozen primary-sample MOP occurrences were classified against exact assembly-matched NCBI/SGD annotations using the classifier frozen in v0.0.13.
567/1000 sampled token types have at least one identical broad primary annotation class represented in all three genomes; this is coarse context concordance, not homology.

The supported variable-slot vocabulary is distributed across multiple biological context classes rather than being semantically promoted from a hand-selected locus; detailed functional identity of individual MOP tokens remains unresolved.

semantics.validated_identity: unbiased descriptive biological-context classification of frozen MOP primary sample

unknowns: Context enrichment relative to genome-wide background.
Functional significance of individual sampled tokens.
